This '''[[V-series droid supervisor/Legends|V-series droid supervisor]]''' was stationed at [[Imperial Relay Outpost V-798]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]], in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Biography==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the commanding officer of the relay station on Vaal, [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Reybn]], was using the droid as a means to protect his face while sunbathing. Another soldier, [[Privitt]], remarked that it was illegal to use [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in that way.
